name: yunqian
description: 云签 YunQian - 跨浏览器书签汇集与链接导航

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @yunqian/server run build && npm --workspace @yunqian/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @yunqian/server run typecheck && npm --workspace @yunqian/web run typecheck
